title: 2025-10-06 Weekly Edit Proposal
author: 0xldr
summary: On behalf of @atlas-axis , we are submitting the Atlas Edit Weekly Cycle proposal below. Note that due to the size of the proposal it will be split into multiple posts. This proposal includes the following edits: Introduce Keel - Updates references from Launch Agent 2 to Keel now that Keel has publicly launched. Specify Near Term Logic For October Monthly Settlement Cycle - Specifies that Amatsu will only prepare the Initial Calculation with respect to Spark for the October Monthly Settlement Cycle. Specify Expected Timing For Stage 2 Of Monthly Settlement Cycle Implementation - Adds an expected timeline of January 1, 2026 for Stage 2 of the implementation of the Monthly Settlement Cycle. Clarify Definition Of Genesis Capital - Clarifies the definition of Genesis Capital for the Genesis Capital Backstop. Define Capped SKY Oracle Wrapper - Defines the Capped SKY Oracle wrapper to prepare for the launch of stUSDS. Allow Direct Investment In Pendle PTs - Allows Prime Agents to invest directly in Pendle PTs backed by Ethena Exposures and defines the Required Risk Capital for doing so. Implement Equivalent Loss Framework For Real World Assets - Implements an Equivalent Loss framework for Real World Assets to reflect the lower risk of these assets due to the possibility of recovery through legal recourse. Increase Required Risk Capital For Superstate - Increases the Required Risk Capital Percentage for USCC. Add Near Term Logic For Plume - Adds near term risk requirements for Plume to support Grove’s investment into ACRDX. Define The Executive Process - Adds an initial end-to-end process definition for the Sky Executive Process. Introduce Keel Update references to Launch Agent 2 and minor related edits as specified in the linked Pull Request: Forthcoming Atlas Edit Weekly Cycle Proposal by aa-lex · Pull Request #65 · sky-ecosystem/next-gen-atlas · GitHub Specify Near Term Logic For October Monthly Settlement Cycle Add a new subdocument of A.2.5.1.2.1.6 - Interim Measures (Portal) / A.2.6 - Sky Core Monthly Settlement Cycle - Monthly Settlement Cycle Overview - Implementation - Process Definition - Interim Measures (GitHub) . This document should be located directly after A.2.5.1.2.1.6.2 - Process For September 2025 Monthly Settlement Cycle (Portal) / A.2.6 - Sky Core Monthly Settlement Cycle - Monthly Settlement Cycle Overview - Implementation - Process Definition - Interim Measures - Process For September 2025 Monthly Settlement Cycle (GitHub) to read as follows: A.2.6 - Process For October 2025 Monthly Settlement Cycle (Core) - For the Monthly Settlement Cycle conducted in October 2025, the Initial Calculation prepared by Operational Executor Agent Amatsu will only include calculations related to Spark. The Independent Calculation prepared by BA Labs on behalf of the Core Council will be prepared normally. The calculations related to Spark will be subject to the normal resolution process defined in A.2.6 - Resolution Of Differences By Core GovOps Atlas Axis . For all other calculations, the amounts in the Independent Calculation will be treated as Agreed Amounts. Specify Expected Timing For Stage 2 Of Monthly Settlement Cycle Implementation Replace A.2.5.1.2.2.2.2 - Stage 2 Timing (Portal) / A.2.6 - Sky Core Monthly Settlement Cycle - Monthly Settlement Cycle Overview - Implementation - Implementation Stages - Stage 2 - Stage 2 Timing (GitHub) to read as follows: Stage 2 Timing (Core) - Stage 2 is currently expected to be implemented in the February 2026 Monthly Settlement Cycle for the period from January 1, 2026 to January 31, 2026. Clarify Definition Of Genesis Capital Replace A.3.8.1.5 - Genesis Capital Backstop (Portal) / A.3.9 - Genesis Capital Backstop (GitHub) to read as follows: A.3.9 - Genesis Capital Backstop (Core) - If a “SKY Backstop Event” is in progress and the SKY price equals zero, the Sky Protocol must apply a pro‑rata haircut across each Genesis Agent’s Genesis Capital, implemented as a transfer of eligible assets from each Agent to the Sky Surplus Buffer. The haircut must be sized exactly to restore the Surplus Buffer to zero. Add a new subdocument of A.3.8.1.5 - Genesis Capital Backstop (Portal) / A.3.9 - Genesis Capital Backstop (GitHub) . This document should be located directly after A.3.8.1.5.5 - Genesis Agents (Portal) / A.3.9 - Genesis Agents to read as follows: A.3.9 - Genesis Capital (Core) - The Genesis Capital of an Agent is the lesser of (1) the amount of capital contributed by Sky to the Agent and (2) the total capital of the Agent. Define Capped SKY Oracle Wrapper Add new subdocuments of A.4.4.1.2 - SKY-Backed Borrowing (Portal) / A.4.4 - SKY Staking Mechanism - SKY Staking - SKY-Backed Borrowing (GitHub) . These documents should be located directly after A.4.4.1.2.8 - stUSDS Bounded External Access Module (Portal) / A.4.4 - SKY Staking Mechanism - SKY Staking - SKY-Backed Borrowing - stUSDS Bounded External Access Module (GitHub) and its subdocuments to read as follows: A.4.4 - SKY-Backed Borrowing Capped OSM Wrapper (Core) - In order to prevent excessive price spikes if there is high demand for leverage against SKY tokens, which could potentially lead to excessive USDS borrowing against SKY, a wrapper for the SKY OSM contract has been developed. The wrapper enforces an upper limit on the price of SKY for the purposes of SKY-Backed Borrowing, which is set to be the minimum value of: The current price reported by PIP_SKY. The cap that has been set on the OSM wrapper contract. A.4.4 - Cap Parameter (Core) - The subdocuments herein further describe the cap parameter and the process for its modification. A.4.4 - Definition (Core) - The cap parameter represents one of the potential inputs for the SKY-Backed Borrowing Capped OSM Wrapper. The OSM wrapper uses the minimum value of the cap or the PIP_SKY oracle price to determine the price utilized for SKY-backed borrowing. A.4.4 - Modification (Core) - The Core Facilitator, in consultation with BA Labs, has the ability to modify the cap parameter. The modification of said parameter is pursuant to the Operational Weekly Cycle and can be effected directly via an Executive Vote, without requiring a prior Governance Poll. A.4.4 - Current Value (Core) - The current value of the cap parameter is: 0.04 USDS. Allow Direct Investment In Pendle PTs Replace A.3.3.2.1.1.1.2.1.1.1 - Ethena Required Risk Capital (Portal) / A.3.3 - Ethena Required Risk Capital (GitHub) to read as follows: A.3.3 - Ethena Required Risk Capital (Core) - Ethena Exposures consist of Direct Ethena Exposures (see A.3.3 - Direct Ethena Exposures ), Indirect Ethena Exposures (see A.3.3 - Indirect Ethena Exposures ), and Pendle Ethena Exposures (see A.3.3 - Pendle Ethena Exposures). The Instance Financial RRC for Ethena Exposures is specified in the documents herein. Add new subdocuments of A.3.3.2.1.1.1.2.1.1.1 - Ethena Required Risk Capital (Portal) / A.3.3 - Ethena Required Risk Capital (GitHub) . These documents should be located directly after A.3.3.2.1.1.1.2.1.1.1.2 - Indirect Ethena Exposures(Portal) / A.3.3 - Indirect Ethena Exposures (GitHub) and its subdocuments to read as follows: A.3.3 - Pendle Ethena Exposures (Core) - Pendle Ethena Exposures are exposures from directly holding PT-USDe or PT-sUSDe. The Instance Financial RRC for Pendle Ethena Exposures is specified in the documents herein. A.3.3 - Maturity Greater Than Six Months (Core) - Pendle Ethena Exposures with more than six (6) months to maturity require 100% Instance Total RRC. A.3.3 - Maturity Less Than Or Equal To Six Months (Core) - Pendle Ethena Exposures with less than or equal to six (6) months to maturity have Instance Financial RRC calculated as follows: Instance Financial RRC = initialValue - ((currentTime - startTime) * decayRatePerSecond) The parameters of this formula are defined in the documents herein. A.3.3 - Initial Value (Core) - The Initial Value initialValue is the Instance Financial RRC when the PT has exactly six (6) months to maturity. The initialValue is 15%. A.3.3 - Current Time (Core) - The Current Time currentTime is the timestamp of the current Ethereum block. A.3.3 - Start Time (Core) - The Start Time startTime is the timestamp of the block exactly six (6) months before the expiration timestamp of the PT. A.3.3 - Decay Rate Per Second (Core) - The Decay Rate Per Second decayRatePerSecond is calculated as follows: decayRatePerSecond = totalDecay / totalDuration The parameters of this formula are defined in the documents herein. A.3.3 - Total Decay (Core) - The Total Decay totalDecay is equal to the Initial Value minus the Final Value. A.3.3 - Final Value (Core) - The Final Value is the Instance Financial RRC when the PT is at maturity. Since the PT is convertible into the underlying asset at this point it is equal to the Instance Financial RRC for Direct Ethena Exposures specified in A.3.3 - Direct Ethena Exposures . A.3.3 - Total Duration (Core) - The Total Duration totalDuration is equal to the Expiration Time minus the Start Time. A.3.3 - Expiration Time (Core) - The Expiration Time is the expiration timestamp of the PT. A.3.3 - Concentration Limit (Core) - Any investments made by Prime Agents in Pendle Ethena Exposures in excess of 20% of their total Allocation System Investments require 100% Instance Total RRC. Replace the subdocuments of A.3.3.2.1.1.1.2.1.1.2 - Ethena Aggregate Exposure Limits (Portal) / A.3.3 - Ethena Aggregate Exposure Limits (GitHub) to read as follows: A.3.3 - Ethena Aggregate Exposure (Core) - Ethena Aggregate Exposure is the sum of Ethena Exposures (see A.3.3 - Ethena Required Risk Capital ) across all Prime Agents in the Sky Ecosystem. A.3.3 - Ethena Aggregate Exposure Limit (Core) - The Ethena Aggregate Exposure Limit is 1,300,000,000 USDS. A.3.3 - Ethena Exposure Limit (Core) - The Ethena Exposure Limit for each Agent is: Spark - One half of the Ethena Aggregate Exposure Limit Grove - One half of the Ethena Aggregate Exposure Limit All other Prime Agents - Zero A.3.3 - Prohibition On Investments That Would Cause Ethena Exposure Limit To Be Exceeded (Core) - No Prime Agent may make an investment in Ethena Exposures that would cause its Ethena Exposures to exceed its Ethena Exposure Limit. A.3.3 - Sale Of Investments When Ethena Exposure Limit Is Exceeded (Core) - If a Prime Agent’s Ethena Exposures exceed its Ethena Exposure Limit, then the Core Council may direct the Agent to sell Ethena Exposures to reduce its Ethena Exposures below its Ethena Exposure Limit. Implement Equivalent Loss Framework For Real World Assets Delete A.3.3.2.1.2.4.1 - Real World Assets (Portal) / A.3.3 - Real World Assets (GitHub) and its subdocuments Add new subdocuments of A.3.3.2.1.2.4 - Exceptions (Portal) / A.3.3 - Exceptions (GitHub) . These documents should be located directly before A.3.3.2.1.2.4.2 - Ethena (Portal) / A.3.3 - Ethena (GitHub) to read as follows: A.3.3 - BUIDL, JTRSY, USTB, And JAAA (Core) - In the short term, investments in BUIDL, JTRSY, USTB, and JAAA have Instance Smart Contract RRC and Instance Administrative RRC of zero. A.3.3 - Legal Recourse Assets (Core) - The exposure for investments in Legal Recourse Assets is calculated as specified in the documents herein. A.3.3 - Definition (Core) - Legal Recourse Assets (”LRAs”) are Real World Assets where legal recourse can be used to recover the assets even if the smart contract is technically hacked or exploited. A.3.3 - Exposure Calculation (Core) - The exposure for investments in Legal Recourse Assets is calculated according to the following formula: Exposure = Equivalent Loss * Effective Age + Raw Exposure * (1 - Effective Age) The parameters of this formula are defined in the documents herein. A.3.3 - Equivalent Loss (Core) - Equivalent Loss is an estimate of the loss that the holder of a Legal Recourse Asset would experience if they had to use legal recourse to recover the assets, based on a combination of expected time to recovery and litigation financing costs. It is calculated according to the following formula: Equivalent Loss = Raw Exposure * Expected Frozen Duration * Litigation Financing Costs The parameters of this formula are defined in the documents herein. A.3.3 - Raw Exposure (Core) - Raw Exposure is specified in A.3.3 - Raw Exposure. A.3.3 - Expected Frozen Duration (Core) - Expected Frozen Duration is the estimated time, in years or fractions thereof, that the Legal Recourse Asset would remain frozen after a hack or technical exploit before the holder would be able to recover the underlying assets through legal recourse. The value of the Expected Frozen Duration is 0.5. A.3.3 - Litigation Financing Costs (Core) - Litigation Financing Costs are the annual costs of borrowing against the right to receive the future recovery of the assets underlying the Legal Recourse Asset through legal recourse. The value of the Litigation Financing Costs is 20%. A.3.3 - Effective Age (Core) - The Effective Age is calculated as specified in A.3.3 - Effective Age except that the Effective Age cannot exceed one (1) year. A.3.3 - Raw Exposure (Core) - The Raw Exposure is the total exposure to the particular Allocation System opportunity. Delete A.3.3.2.1.3.3.1 - Real World Assets (Portal) / A.3.3 - Real World Assets (GitHub) Add new subdocuments of A.3.3.2.1.3.3 - Exceptions (Portal) / A.3.3 - Exceptions (GitHub) . These documents should be located directly before A.3.3.2.1.3.3.2 - Ethena (Portal) / A.3.3 - Ethena (GitHub) to read as follows: A.3.3 - BUIDL, JTRSY, USTB, And JAAA (Core) - The Administrative RRC for BUIDL, JTRSY, USTB, and JAAA is calculated as specified in A.3.3 - BUIDL, JTRSY, USTB, And JAAA. A.3.3 - Legal Recourse Assets (Core) - The exposure for investments in Legal Recourse Assets is calculated as specified in A.3.3 - Legal Recourse Assets. Superstate Exposures have a 4.5% Instance Financial RRC Ratio. Add Near Term Logic For Plume Add a new subdocument of A.3.3.2.1.1.1.5.3 - Exceptions (Portal) / A.3.3 - Exceptions (GitHub) . This document should be located directly after A.3.3.2.1.1.1.5.3.1 - Instance Financial RRC Ratios For Specific Assets (Portal) / A.3.3 - Instance Financial RRC Ratios For Specific Assets (GitHub) and its subdocuments to read as follows: A.3.3 - Restrictions On Investments On Plume (Core) - Investments on Plume are subject to the following restrictions: Assets other than RWAs on Plume or being bridged to Plume require 100% Instance Total RRC; and Total investments on Plume may not exceed 125 million USDS.
